name: Shingles
overview: Shingles is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, shingles, also known as herpes zoster or zona, is a viral disease characterized by a painful skin rash with blisters in a localized area.
In routine practice, typically the rash occurs in a single, wide mark either on the left or right side of the body or face.
From a clinical perspective, other common symptoms are fever, headache, and tiredness.
In routine practice, the rash usually heals within four weeks, but some people develop ongoing nerve pain which can last for months or years...
